report_name: GitHub Supply Chain Attack Steals CI/CD Secrets with 'wfx' Malware

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used compromised developer accounts with write access to push malicious commits to GitHub repositories.

attack_patterns.name: Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools
attack_patterns.description: The attack involved injecting the wfx stealer into GitHub Actions workflow files, compromising the CI/CD development tools.

attack_patterns.name: Unsecured Credentials
attack_patterns.description: The wfx stealer was designed to harvest unsecured CI/CD secrets from the GitHub Actions environment, including repository secrets, cloud credentials, and API keys.

attack_patterns.name: File Deletion
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used the GitHub API to delete the logs from the malicious workflow run to hide evidence of the compromise, as part of a 'sandwich-commit' technique.

malware.name: wfx
malware.description: A custom information stealer designed to run within GitHub Actions to harvest credentials from CI/CD environments, including repository secrets, cloud credentials, and API keys.

tools.name: curl
tools.description: Used within GitHub Actions logs to send exfiltrated data to unknown external domains.

tools.name: wget
tools.description: Used within GitHub Actions logs to send exfiltrated data to unknown external domains.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.description: A leaked GitHub CLI token was used as an initial access vector in one case of the campaign.

identities.name: GitHub
identities.description: The targeted ecosystem for a large-scale software supply chain attack. The attack leverages compromised developer accounts and injects malware into GitHub Actions.

identities.name: webdriverio
identities.description: An open-source project that was a confirmed victim of the wfx stealer attack, though the malicious commit was detected and reverted quickly.

infrastructure.name: wfx Stealer Exfiltration Endpoint
infrastructure.description: Unknown external domains used as endpoints for exfiltrating stolen CI/CD secrets and credentials from GitHub Actions environments via curl or wget.

indicators.name: GitHub Workflow Run Log Deletion API Call
indicators.pattern:
title: GitHub Workflow Run Log Deletion API Call
id: 7f5b1a3c-8e4d-4f9a-9c2b-1a2d3e4f5a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects API calls that delete GitHub Actions workflow run logs, a key evasion technique used in the wfx stealer campaign.
references:
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/github-actions-supply-chain-attack-targeting-ci-secrets-at-scale
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-12
tags:
  - attack.t1070.004
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'DELETE'
    c-uri|re: '/actions/runs/\d+/logs$'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects API calls that delete GitHub Actions workflow run logs, a key evasion technique used in the wfx stealer campaign to remove evidence of compromise.

indicators.name: Suspicious Egress from GitHub Actions Runner
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Egress from GitHub Actions Runner
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious use of curl or wget within a GitHub Actions runner to exfiltrate data, as seen with the wfx stealer.
references:
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/github-actions-supply-chain-attack-targeting-ci-secrets-at-scale
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-12
tags:
  - attack.t1041
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_curl:
    Image|endswith: '/curl'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -X POST '
  selection_wget:
    Image|endswith: '/wget'
    CommandLine|contains: ' --post-data'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate CI/CD processes that post data to external services (e.g., webhooks, notifications). Requires tuning for known-good destinations.
indicators.description: Detects suspicious use of curl or wget within a GitHub Actions runner to exfiltrate data, a TTP associated with the wfx stealer.

indicators.name: Suspicious GitHub Workflow File Modification
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious GitHub Workflow File Modification
id: c5d6e7f8-a9b0-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f
status: experimental
description: Monitors for modifications to GitHub Actions workflow files, which could indicate the injection of malicious code like the wfx stealer.
references:
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/github-actions-supply-chain-attack-targeting-ci-secrets-at-scale
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-12
tags:
  - attack.t1195.001
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '.github/workflows/'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.yml'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate developer changes to CI/CD workflows. This rule is best used for hunting and requires correlation with user activity.
indicators.description: Detects modifications to GitHub Actions workflow files, which could indicate the injection of malicious code like the wfx stealer.
